frames.name: Portal Users
frames.implementation: Rebuilt sidebar/top bar, 4 content columns, metadata/status, selection, actions, role/status filters and search.

frames.name: Students
frames.implementation: Matched Back/title/CTA positions, six columns, row spacing and assignment/status treatments.

frames.name: Add students — details
frames.implementation: Restored four-field row, numbered entry, saved assignments, Delete/Edit, reuse checkbox and Add Another. Measured final populated dialog 960 × 787.2.

frames.name: Add students — review
frames.implementation: Restored stepper, email list, Delete/Edit, required confirmation and footer. Counts reflect actual drafts.

frames.name: Add students — results
frames.implementation: Added per-row Sending/Sent/Failed results, partial success summary, retry failed invitations and invitation-list route. Completion copy follows actual completion.

frames.name: CSV upload — idle
frames.implementation: Matched instruction panel, file drop zone, CSV template and disabled Continue footer.
frames.route: Students → Add students → Upload a CSV

frames.name: CSV upload — drag over
frames.implementation: Added drag-over border/background and file drop handlers; rejected unsupported/oversize files. OS drag-and-drop not directly exercised.
frames.route: Drag a CSV over the drop zone

frames.name: CSV upload — uploading
frames.implementation: Restored filename/file size, progress bar and explicit intermediate 70% state with disabled Continue.
frames.route: Choose CSV or profile → Use sample CSV

frames.name: CSV upload — ready
frames.implementation: Restored 100% Ready state, remove-file action, enabled Continue; no automatic advance.

frames.name: Add to Team picker
frames.implementation: Searchable choices, selected row, Done gating and Create new team continuation.

frames.name: CSV Review Students
frames.implementation: Matched warning summary, correction links, status, filter/search/action toolbar and table. Ready/error counts are data-dependent.

frames.name: Add Sub-Org picker
frames.implementation: Compact searchable two-option picker, selected state and Done. Final browser measurement 562 × 390.

frames.name: Add Voucher picker
frames.implementation: Searchable voucher options, selected row and Done; corrected runtime error that previously prevented opening.

frames.name: Portal invitation — review
frames.implementation: Restored white Summary, assignment breakdown and can/cannot columns, confirmation and edit/back behaviour.
frames.route: Invite Portal user → complete required scope → Review Invitation

frames.name: Portal invitation — success
frames.implementation: Restored compact icon/message composition and Done footer, with pending invitation persisted locally.

frames.name: Portal invitation — details
frames.implementation: Email-only details, 3 roles, All Groups, voucher/team search, Select all, membership counts and permission summary. Tall content scrolls with footer visible.
